# technitium_record_soa (Resource)

Manages the `SOA` record of an authoritative zone. The record always exists: creating the resource updates it, and destroying the resource leaves it as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_zone" "soa_home" {
  zone = "home.example.com"
}

resource "technitium_record_soa" "home" {
  zone                   = technitium_zone.soa_home.zone
  domain                 = technitium_zone.soa_home.zone
  responsible_person     = "hostmaster@home.example.com"
  use_serial_date_scheme = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The zone apex, the same name as `zone`.
- `zone` (String) The name of the zone.

### Optional

- `expire` (Number) The seconds after which secondary name servers stop answering for the zone when they cannot refresh it.
- `minimum` (Number) The TTL in seconds for caching negative answers from the zone.
- `primary_name_server` (String) The primary name server of the zone.
- `refresh` (Number) The seconds secondary name servers wait before checking the zone for changes.
- `responsible_person` (String) The email address of the person responsible for the zone.
- `retry` (Number) The seconds secondary name servers wait before retrying a failed refresh.
- `ttl` (Number) The TTL of the `SOA` record in seconds.
- `use_serial_date_scheme` (Boolean) Use the date scheme (YYYYMMDDnn) for the serial. Applies to `Primary`, `Forwarder` and `Catalog` zones.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `serial` (Number) The zone serial. The server increments it on every change to the zone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_record_soa.home home.example.com/home.example.com
```
